s: strI, (paritaH Kanyate iti । Kan + “anyezva'pIti .” 3 । 2 । 101 । qaH .) rAjaGAnyAdivezwanaKAtam । iti BarataH ॥ gaqaKAi iti KAnA iti ca yasyAH prasidDiH । tatparyyAyaH ॥ Keyam । ityamaraH । 1 । 10 । 29 ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 7 । 196 । “BindyAccEva taqAgAni prAkArapariKAstaTA । samavaskandayeccEnaM rAtrO vitrAsayettaTA ॥”) tasyA mAnaM yaTA, -- “prasTe ca pariKAmAnaM SatahastaM praSastakam । paritaH SivirARAYca gamBIraM daSahastakam ॥” saNketapUrvvakaYcEva pariKAdvAramIpsitam । SatroragamyaM mitrasya gamyameva suKena ca ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 202 aDyAyaH ॥

m: परि-खा f. (once ibc. ˚ख, BhP.) a moat, ditch, trench or fosse round a town or fort (also applied to the sea surrounding the earth), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
N. of a village in the North country g. पलद्य्-आदि (iv, 2, 110)
a: परिखा — A moat, ditch, trench round a fort or town; R. 1. 30; 12. 66.

k.v: खेयं तु परिखाधारस्त्वम्भसां यत्र धारणम्. स्यादालवालमावालमावापोऽथ नदी सरित्.।

m: परि-खा—स्थित mfn. impregnable, secure, MBh. xii, 6250

v: na॰ paritaH KAtam । 1 pariKAyAm । 2 pariKana karmaRi tri॰ ।
m: परि-खात mfn. dug round
परि-खात m. a furrow, rut, BhP.
a: परिखातं — 1 A moat, ditch. --2 A rut, furrow. --3 Digging round.

m: परि-˚खी-कृत mfn. made into a moat or ditch, Ragh. i, 30.

a: परिखंडयति — Den. P. To humiliate, conquer.

m: परि-खण्ड See परि-षण्ड.
परि-खण्डन See मान-परिख्˚.
परि-खण्डय Nom. P. ˚यति, to make small, break, conquer, Bālar.; Bhaṭṭ.
परि-खचित mfn. (√ खच्) strewn or inlaid with (comp.), Kāraṇḍ.
परि-√ खन् (only ind.p. -खाय), to dig round, dig up, ĀśvGṛ.
परि-खेद m. (ifc. f(आ). ) lassitude, weariness, exhaustion, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: परिखेदः — Fatigue, exhaustion, lassitude; Ku. 1. 60; Rs. 1. 27.

m: परि-खेदित mfn. (fr. Caus.) afflicted, exhausted, ruined, destroyed, Kāv.; BhP.
परि-√ खिद् P. -खिद्यति, to be depressed or afflicted, feel uneasy, BhP. : Caus. -खेदयति, to trouble, afflict, destroy, ib. &c.
a: परिखिद् — {c4c} P. To suffer pain or misery, be distressed or wearied. --Caus. To injure, hurt.

m: परि-खिन्न mfn. depressed, afflicted, exhausted, MBh.; R. &c.

परि-√ ख्या P. -ख्याति (Subj. -ख्यतम्, -ख्यन्, RV.), to look round, look at, perceive, RV. &c. &c.; to observe, regard, consider, MBh.; R.; to overlook, disregard, RV. : Pass. -ख्यायते, to be perceived, ChUp.
a: परिख्या — {c2c} P. 1 Ved. To look at, perceive. --2 To regard, consider.
